attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on November 6, 2026. The company published the results in the Financial Express and AKkali Patrika on November 8, 2026. Statutory auditors conducted a limited review of the financials. The results comply with Indian Accounting Standards. The company operates in the Construction and Real Estate Development segment. Investor complaints pending at the start of the quarter were nil, with no new complaints received. The financial data is available on the company website and stock exchange platforms. The announcement was signed by Company Secretary Aarti Mahajan on November 6, 2026, in Jalandhar.

attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the opening of a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. The floor price for the issue is set at Rs. 269.205 per equity share. This pricing is based on a relevant date of November 12, 2026. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on this floor price. The Board also approved the preliminary placement document dated November 12, 2026. This document will be sent to qualified institutional buyers to invite bids. The trading window for designated persons is closed from November 12, 2026, until 48 hours after the issue price determination. The preliminary placement document will be filed with the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited has closed its trading window for dealing in company securities for all Designated Persons and their immediate relatives. This closure is effective from Thursday, November 12, 2026, and will remain in place until 48 hours after the determination of the Issue Price. The closure is in connection with the proposed Qualified Institutions Placement for which In-Principle Approval was received on November 12, 2026. The notice was issued by Aarti Mahajan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The intimation was submitted to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI regulations and the company's code of conduct. The notice is also available on the company website at www.agiinfra.com.
